head_coach.name: Didier Deschamps
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic approach emphasizing defensive solidity, structured transitions, and exploiting individual quality and pace on the counter-attack.

key_players.name: Kylian Mbappé
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 42 goals and provided 7 assists in 44 matches for Real Madrid in the 2025-26 season, and 5 goals in 4 matches for France.

key_players.name: William Saliba
key_players.performance_stats: Anchors the defense for both Arsenal and France, establishing himself as one of the premier center-backs in world football.

key_players.name: Aurélien Tchouaméni
key_players.performance_stats: Serves as a crucial tactical anchor and deep-lying playmaker for Real Madrid and the French national team.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sidelined with a ruptured Achilles tendon, officially ruling him out of the 2026 World Cup.
